app_advisories.summary: Publish readiness metadata only; natural runtime supports scoped observation, not permanent reliability.
Notifier receipts prove readiness state only; stale-temp cleanup and GMUT claims remain outside this evidence.
Use final-message, notifier, stale-temp, and publication-lint schemas with expected-negative fixture rows.

notifier_contract: watch final-message files without forcing short runtime
exclude raw stdout and stderr from publication
record hashes, byte counts, and marker counts
